name: Silverstream Riverbank
description: A peaceful riverbank lookout beside Silverstream, with flowing water and benches. An optional destination for river watching, quiet reflection or meeting a friend on dry land.

name: Silverstream Riverside Walk
description: A riverside walkway with shaded seating beside Silverstream. Choose a leisurely walk here or continue to the nearby riverbank in your free time.

name: Cloudpeak Mountain Lookout
description: A mountain viewpoint with rocky peaks and a level resting area at their foot. An optional spot for sightseeing, fresh air and enjoying the mountain scenery.

name: Pinecrest Hill Station
description: A leafy hill-station retreat with rolling hills and outdoor lookout seating. Visit for a relaxing break or use it as a stop on a self-chosen trek through the Highlands.

name: Pine Ridge Trekking Trail
description: A marked trekking-friendly woodland trailhead with a resting bench. For an optional longer outing, walk between this trail, Pinecrest Hill Station and Cloudpeak Mountain Lookout using MOVE; choose your own pace and rest when needed.

name: New Eden Galleria
description: An indoor mall with a bright atrium and communal lounge. An optional place for window-shopping, meeting friends or relaxing out of the rain; browsing requires no purchase.
